title: Fan Page Manager — Run Monster Run
description:
About the Role

Run Monster Run is looking for a creative social media enthusiast to help grow our presence on TikTok and Instagram and build a community of people who genuinely love our content.

Your mission? Turn our existing animation into scroll-stopping clips, hilarious moments, and content people want to share with their friends. But it's not just about chasing views or racking up followers. We want to reach the right audience: people who connect with our characters, get invested in our stories, and want to engage with the world of Run Monster Run.

We're looking for someone who knows their way around social media, can spot a viral moment from a mile away, and understands what makes people stop scrolling, hit share, leave a comment, and come back for more.

You don't need to be a professional video editor with years of experience. We care more about your creativity, social media instincts, understanding of online fandoms, and ability to create content that gets people genuinely excited about what they're watching.

What You'll Do

• Run and grow Run Monster Run's TikTok and Instagram fan pages, keeping the content fresh, engaging, and consistent.

• Hunt for the funniest, wildest, most surprising, or most memorable moments in our animated episodes and turn them into short-form videos people want to share.

• Edit and repurpose existing content into clips that capture attention and introduce new audiences to Run Monster Run.

• Find creative ways to connect with fans, spark conversations, and encourage people to engage with our characters and stories.

• Stay on top of social media trends, viral formats, and fandom culture to spot opportunities that make sense for our audience.

• Experiment with hooks, captions, editing styles, and formats to discover what resonates with viewers.

• Keep an eye on performance, looking beyond views and follower counts to understand what drives meaningful engagement, shares, comments, and repeat interactions.

• Build a consistent posting rhythm while making sure every piece of content feels relevant to the Run Monster Run audience and the world of the show.

What We're Looking For

• Hands-on experience managing TikTok and/or Instagram accounts, ideally with a track record of growing an audience and generating strong engagement.

• A portfolio of short-form edits, clips, Reels, or other social-media-first content that demonstrates your creativity and ability to capture attention.

• Strong instincts for identifying compelling moments and turning them into content that makes people laugh, react, comment, or share.

• A solid understanding of internet culture, viral trends, and online fandoms, including what makes people connect with a show, its characters, and its stories.

• An audience-first mindset: you understand that building a successful account is about more than follower counts. You care about attracting people who genuinely connect with the content and want to engage with it.

• Experience growing fan pages, entertainment accounts, or social media accounts built around existing shows, characters, celebrities, or other IPs.

• A genuine interest in animation and animated shows, with an appreciation for the communities and fandoms that grow around them.

• A creative, proactive approach to testing ideas, learning from results, and finding new ways to grow an engaged audience.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

title: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer
description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customersuccess with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands. Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

Role Overview

The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer designs, implements, and operates identity and access capabilities for human users, non-human identities, workloads, devices, services, and AI agents. The role focuses on the subject side of access control-identity, authentication, roles, groups, entitlements, and privileges-with an emphasis on least privilege, separation of duties, strong authentication, automated lifecycle management, and short-lived credentials.

The engineer partners with others across the organization to ensure applications, infrastructure, and services appropriately mediate access, separate security domains, minimize unnecessary sharing, and limit common mechanisms that could increase privilege or blast radius.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and operate authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, RBAC/ABAC, PAM, conditional access, policy-based authorization, just-in-time access, continuous verification, and privileged-access capabilities.

• Engineer roles, groups, entitlements, and privilege assignments around least privilege and separation of duties.

• Automate identity provisioning, access reviews, privilege changes, revocation, and deprovisioning.

• Implement phishing-resistant MFA, cryptographically bound authentication, and strong identity assurance across enrollment, authentication, federation, and recovery.

• Govern service accounts, machine and device identities, workloads, automated processes, APIs, and AI-agent identities.

• Implement short-lived workload and agent identities using federation, certificates, and modern workload-identity approaches while reducing reliance on persistent secrets.

• Partner with architects, engineers, and resource owners to ensure access is efficiently mediated and designs minimize excessive privilege, unnecessary sharing, and cross-domain exposure.

• Monitor identity posture and partner with Security Operations to investigate identity threats and rapidly revoke compromised access.

Qualifications

• Hands-on experience engineering enterprise IAM systems and integrations.

• Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, federation, identity lifecycle management, role/group design, separation of duties, and least privilege.

• Knowledge of phishing-resistant MFA, cryptographic authentication, identity proofing, federation, and modern identity assurance practices.

• Experience managing human and non-human identities, including service, machine, workload, or device identities.

• Experience automating identity processes using APIs, scripting, or Infrastructure-as-Code.

• Understanding of PKI, secrets management, short-lived credentials, workload identity federation, and technologies such as OIDC, OAuth, and SPIFFE/SPIRE.

• Ability to reason about identity and authorization across distributed systems and collaborate with architects and engineers on secure access design.

• RSU grants for full-time employees 

• ESPP program

• Brand Taste & Intimates Standards: Protect visual quality, model portrayal, and compliance for women's intimates (tasteful framing, hygiene/fit sensitivity, region-specific ad policies).

• Cross-Functional Rhythm: Partner with marketing leadership, media buyers, designers, and copywriters during Shenzhen hours; take briefs, flag what’s missing, and turn around revisions fast.

What You Bring
Required (Must-Haves):

• 5+ years of professional video editing, with 2+ years in performance creative, e-commerce, or social ads (DTC or marketplaces).

• AI Champion & Power User: Hands-on, current experience with modern AI video/image/audio tools and automated edit workflows - not “curious,” but shipping with them weekly.

• Craft Mastery: Expert in at least one professional NLE (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut/Jianying at a professional standard), plus motion typography, color, sound design, and captioning.

• Portfolio of shipped ads or social/video work with clear before/after or performance context (hook tests, CTR/thumb-stop, iterative versions). We will judge taste and conversion-mindedness, not reel length.

Spectrum Control is seeking a Senior Contracts Manager to support customer contract review, negotiation, and administration across all U.S. businesses. We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Inside Sales Executive to drive lead generation and business development activities for our AI, Data Analytics, and Digital Transformation services across the APAC region, primarily focusing on the Singapore market.
The candidate will be responsible for identifying and reaching out to senior decision-makers, including C-level executives, IT Directors, CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Data, and other technology leaders within IT companies and enterprises.
The primary objective is to generate qualified business leads, initiate conversations with potential clients, qualify opportunities, and arrange meetings between prospective customers and our senior sales/business leadership team to explore potential AI and Data project opportunities.
The role will be performed remotely from an offshore location, requiring strong communication skills, confidence in engaging senior stakeholders, and the ability to build a consistent sales pipeline in the Singapore market.
Key Responsibilities
1. Lead Generation & Prospect Identification

• Identify potential customers, target companies, and business opportunities across Singapore and the wider APAC market.

• Build and maintain a database of IT companies, enterprises, financial institutions, and other potential customers.

• Research organisations to identify relevant decision-makers, including CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, IT Directors, and Heads of Data and Analytics.

• Generate leads through LinkedIn, online research, company databases, networking platforms, and other prospecting channels.

2. Outbound Calling & C-Level Engagement

• Conduct outbound cold calls and email campaigns to prospective customers.

• Proactively reach out to C-level executives, business heads, IT leaders, and technology decision-makers.

• Introduce our AI, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, and Digital Transformation capabilities.

• Initiate meaningful business conversations and create interest in our technology services.

• Build relationships with senior stakeholders and identify potential business requirements.

3. Lead Qualification & Opportunity Identification

• Understand the prospect's business challenges, technology landscape, and potential IT requirements.

• Identify opportunities related to AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Cloud Data Platforms, and Digital Transformation.

• Qualify leads based on business needs, project potential, budget, decision-making authority, and timelines.

• Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, follow-ups, and lead status.

4. Meeting Arrangement & Sales Pipeline Development

• Schedule qualified business meetings between prospective customers and the internal sales/business leadership team.

• Ensure meetings are arranged with relevant decision-makers and stakeholders.

• Share meeting briefs, prospect information, business requirements, and opportunity details with the internal team.

• Conduct consistent follow-ups to convert initial conversations into meaningful business discussions.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified leads and sales opportunities.

5. Market Research & Reporting

• Research the Singapore IT services market and identify potential business opportunities.

• Track competitor activities, market trends, and emerging AI and Data technology requirements.

• Provide regular reports on calls made, prospects contacted, leads generated, meetings arranged, and qualified opportunities.

• Maintain CRM records and ensure timely follow-ups with prospects.

Target Audience
The candidate will primarily engage with:

• CEOs, CIOs, CTOs and CDOs.

• Chief Digital Officers and Chief Technology Officers.

• IT Directors and Heads of Technology.

• Heads of Data, Analytics and AI.

• Heads of Enterprise Architecture and Digital Transformation.

• Business Development and Technology Leaders.

Target Organisations: IT services companies, consulting firms, ban

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. Behind every intelligent machine is a developer building it. - Establish best practices and standards to provide a well-lit-path for development

- A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent

- The ability to owns products end-to-end, from underlying infrastructure to engagement metrics

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents (tool use, agent harnesses, context management, evals) and a clear view of where they fail

- Passion about code quality; modeling best practices in their own wor

title: Talent Partner/Recruiter Fixed Term Contract (6 mths)
Product Manager, Consumer
description:
About DeleteMe: 
DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help Individuals, Families, Businesses and Security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web - the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.
Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.
DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.
DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.
What you’ll own:
The member experience: signup, profile setup, the dashboard, and the privacy reports we deliver every cycle. Members should feel the value the moment they log in.
The privacy toolkit: masked email, phone, and card, plus search engine monitoring. Help us decide what comes next and where we expand internationally.
The growth engine: plan and pricing pages, checkout, renewals, cancellation and save offers, referrals, and promotions. You’ll run pricing tests with Marketing and Finance and see the results quickly.
The lifecycle: the messages that turn a signup into an active member, an upgrade, and a long-term customer.
What your week looks like:
Reading the numbers, then pairing them with support tickets, reviews, and member interviews to find the real problem.
Designing experiments, running them, and being honest about the ones that flop.
Writing tight PRDs and user stories with clear success criteria and edge cases, so engineering can start building right away.
Using AI coding and testing tools to build prototypes and shipping the changes yourself. Engineers spend their time on the hard problems.
Acting as the product point of contact for Support, Customer Success, and Marketing. You own escalations from intake to resolution and close the loop with everyone who raised them.
What you bring:
3 to 5 years of consumer product experience in subscription or B2C SaaS, with real ownership of a checkout, onboarding, or retention surface.
A funnel win. You can tell us the experiment, the metric you moved, and what happened, including the ones that didn’t work.
Data fluency. You’re comfortable with SQL or equivalent and a product analytics tool, and you can spot a bad number before it leads you astray.
Subscription billing know-how. You’ve dealt with Stripe or something similar: plans, coupons, trials, renewals, refunds, and the edge cases that come with them.
Builder instincts. You use AI coding tools daily, have shipped to production yourself, and can hold your own in a conversation with engineers about APIs, schemas, and trade-offs. You also know where AI output falls short and check it before it ships.
Clear writing. Your requirements are complete enough to build from, and your updates are short enough that people actually read them.
A point of view on privacy and consumer trust. Experience in privacy, security, or identity is a plus, but a strong belief in what we do matters more.

Generous 401k matching up to 6%
20 days paid time off
15 sick days
12 company-paid holidays
Childcare expense reimbursement
Fitness and cell phone reimbursement
Birthday time off

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Belgium is one of our expansion markets. Flanders and Wallonia are home to a dense, export-driven manufacturing base, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Belgium from there.

- A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

- You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

- You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Belgium.

- You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS AND ISN’T

- Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

- Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

- Not a remote role: You build Belgium from our Munich office and travel into the market.

YOUR TASKS

- Open up Belgium end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers
Most engineers are given maps.
We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap .
We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12-18 months will define our company for the next decade.
This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.
It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.
We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.
Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.
The Work
You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.
You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.
That means:

• Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

• Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

• Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

• Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.
When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker .
No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here
This role is intentionally polarizing.
You’ll probably thrive here if:

• You build things because you can’t help yourself

• You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

• You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

• You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

•
You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

• you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

• people now depend on it

•
and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards .
For your code.
For your thinking.
And especially for yourself.

What This Is Not
This is not:

• a maintenance role

• a Jira-ticket factory

• a place to hide behind processes

• an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity :
Fast without being sloppy.
Ambitious without being reckless.

The Upside
If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.
You’ll get:

• Ownership over systems that matter

• A small team of other high-agency builders

• Real influence on product and architecture

• Equity that actually means something if we win

• A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

The Filter
This role is not for everyone.
Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.
If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time , you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Certa (certa.ai http://certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to reinvent how Certa gets implemented. Because our no-code Studio lets you configure a workflow simply by describing it - Vibe Configuration℠ - one person can now sit with the customer, understand a requirement as it's spoken, and build it live, so they see their own workflow running in the same session. You'll work directly with Fortune 500 teams across compliance, information security, privacy, legal, procurement, finance, and sustainability - credible enough to discuss vendor-tiering policy with a Chief Procurement Officer, then open Studio and build it. You'll be one of the first people doing this, which means you'll also define how it's done.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Understand the business process: Run discovery and design sessions with Fortune 500 teams across compliance, security, privacy, legal, procurement, finance, and sustainability - often in the same room with competing views - and learn how their third-party processes actually run today, including the parts that live in email, spreadsheets, and people's heads.

- Document & optimize it: Map the current state and agree a target state against the metrics customers actually care about - onboarding cycle time, assessment turnaround, reviewer effort, audit readiness. You're not there to digitize a bad process faithfully, and a workflow that's technically correct but painful to use won't get adopted - so reviewer effort and drop-off are your problem, not theirs.

- Configure & automate it in Certa: Build the workflows, forms, logic, risk scoring, and approvals in Studio using Vibe Configuration℠ - live in the room wherever possible - plus the integrations and data flows into existing systems, and debug them when they break.

- Own the delivery: Own the plan, governance, and test cycle (scenarios and cases, SIT, UAT with the customer's own testers, sanity and regression), then cutover, go-live, hypercare, and a clean handover - accountable for the date and the success metrics behind it.

- Bring learning back from the front lines: Find the platform's real limits before anyone else does and bring them to Product with evidence - the customer, the frequency, the cost of the workaround - and turn what you built into templates and accelerators, so the next deployment starts ahead of where yours did.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Experience: 3+ years in customer-facing technical delivery - forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or technical professional services.

- Hands-on technical skills: Comfortable with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and data mapping; able to script in Python or JavaScript and debug a failure across two systems you didn't build.

- Production LLM experience: You've worked with LLMs in production rather than in demos - prompts, retrieval, agent workflows, and evaluating output systematically rather than by vibes.

- Product-centric & shipping-biased: You think about the user in front of the screen, not the requirement in the document, and favor shipping something usable and iterating over shipping something perfect and late.

- Delivery fluency: You've carried a go-live date in front of a customer, so project plans, RAID logs, phase gates, test scenarios and cases, SIT, UAT, and regression testing are familiar ground.

- Communication: Thoughtful and streamlined - you listen first, hold your own with a Chief Procurement Officer, privacy counsel, and security architect in the same room, and can say no to a customer

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Purpose
Job Purpose
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of large, strategically important customer initiatives, operational workstreams, and transformational projects. This role serves as the primary customer-facing delivery leader, ensuring commitments are delivered on time, within budget, at expected quality levels, and with high customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate combines strong project governance, financial management, stakeholder engagement, people leadership, and continuous improvement capabilities while contributing to account growth and project management maturity.
About Transform
At RWS, we enable the world’s largest enterprises to communicate with global audiences through cutting-edge language technology, AI-driven solutions, and expert services. Our RWS Transform division empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation, scale global content, and unlock growth in every market.
Job Overview
Key Responsibilities

• Lead complex projects and programs, ensuring successful delivery against scope, timelines, quality, and budget objectives while maintaining strong customer relationships and stakeholder engagement.

• Oversee project planning, financial performance, resource allocation, risk management, and delivery KPIs, ensuring operational efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

• Drive project governance and performance reporting, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), executive presentations, financial forecasts, and continuous monitoring of delivery health.

• Identify customer needs and business growth opportunities, supporting proposals, solution development, project estimates, and account expansion initiatives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Mentor and support Project Managers and junior team members, promoting professional development, knowledge sharing, and project management best practices.

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives, overseeing project documentation, SOP governance, knowledge transfer, lessons learned, and process standardization to ensure operational consistency, compliance, and business continuity.

Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of project management experience managing large or complex customer-facing programs.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

• Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, financial performance, and profitability.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams in dynamic operational environments.

• Demonstrated stakeholder management, customer relationship, and executive presentation capabilities.

• Experience mentoring and developing project-management talent.

• Strong risk management, governance, organizational, and communication skills.

• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.

• Experience with project delivery and issue-tracking platforms such as Jira or similar tools.

• SOP governance and documentation management experience.

*** Please send your application in English version ***
Life at RWS
Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.
Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.
In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner , putting clients fist and winning together , to pioneer , innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress , aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver , owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.
